edits.old: Then the smoke workflow reads no recovery_case row, no ACE view and no business table
edits.new:
Then the smoke workflow reads no recovery_case row, no ACE view and no business table

  Scenario: AC13 Error answers 401 and 403 of the provided operations
    Given a caller presents no valid credential to POST /admin/workflows/smoke
    When the caller calls POST /admin/workflows/smoke
    Then the response is 401 with Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-PLT-E1071-APP-AC10)
    Then no workflow starts

  Scenario: AC14 Replay of a write with the same idempotency key
    Given a write to POST /admin/workflows/smoke was made with Idempotency-Key platform-smoke-20261116
    When the same write is replayed with the same Idempotency-Key
    Then the response is 200 with the same run ID and status RUNNING, as in AC4
    Then no second workflow execution starts

  Scenario: AC15 Activity retry and timeout
    Given the smoke activity attempt times out or fails with a retryable error
    When the attempt is retried
    Then the retry policy and timeout are Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-PLT-E1071-APP-AC12)

  Scenario: AC16 Disallowed status change is refused
    Given a status change is requested that the status model does not allow
    When the change is submitted
    Then the change is refused with Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-PLT-E1071-APP-AC13)
    Then no status change is recorded
